normal.text: #20Strong #Nemesis is quite interesting. I played solo, and according to the first game recommendations, I didn't go for solving tasks for points, and instead to just tried to survive. It's got tension, and I can see betrayal lurking for 2- or 3-player games. #AwakenRealms #ChipTheoryGames #gamenight #boardgames

normal.name: thirty-two
normal.text: Got some more progress and accuracy implemented this weekend for a HERCMONO.DRV render filter for my javascript SCI0 renderer. Reworked the CRT phosphor gen to use the wave-length emission range from the data-sheets to get a little more "accurate" projection into sRGB space. Here are simplified P1, P3, P4 phosphors, three classic phosphors for CRTs. Want to implement a phosphor glow for secondary wavelengths at some point. #RetroComputing #RetroGaming #HerculesGraphics
normal.media: 3 images: The swamp scene from Colonels Bequest rendered with P1 phosphors. / The swamp scene from Colonels Bequest rendered with P3 phosphors. / The swamp scene from Colonels Bequest rendered with P4 phosphors.
